commentary.text: 90+10' John Brooks is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+10' Excellent touch by Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
90+9' It will be a substitution. Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) is ready to enter the pitch as Anthony Gordon walks off.
90+8' John Brooks blows his whistle and it's Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90+8' A dangerous looking corner kick from Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is cleared to safety by the defence.
90+8' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
90+5' The game has begun to heat up. Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
90+4' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) for his blatant foul.
90+2' Clement Lenglet (Aston Villa) connects with the corner but his looping header goes well over. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
90+2' Aston Villa earn a corner.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.

90' John McGinn (Aston Villa) collects a simple pass and decides to shoot from distance. It's a swerving effort aimed low towards the middle of the goal, but Martin Dubravka reads it well and makes a comfortable save.

90' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Emiliano Martinez makes a great save.
88' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
87' John Brooks couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) and blew his whistle.
86' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) was too forceful with his tackle and John Brooks interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
85' John Brooks blows for a foul after Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
84' The game is interrupted. John McGinn (Aston Villa) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
84' The current number of corner kicks is 6:7.
81' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Martin Dubravka intercepts the ball.
80' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
79' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
79' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) plants a good close-range header towards goal from the corner kick, but it comes to nothing as a defender comfortably blocks the effort.
78' The referee awards a corner and Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) goes over to take it.
77' John McGinn (Aston Villa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. John Brooks had an easy-decision to make.
75' Here comes a substitution. Lewis Miley is given a rest as he is replaced by Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd).
75' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) heads on.

75' The goal by Aston Villa is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
74' The Aston Villa players joy may have been justified, because referee John Brooks is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.

72' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
71' 1 - 3 Goal Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa)! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) was put through by Leon Bailey and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the top of the net. 1:3.
71' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
70' Aston Villa quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
70' Aston Villa take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

70' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Matty Cash (Aston Villa) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Martin Dubravka pulls off an easy save.
69' Some patient build-up play from Aston Villa as they look to unlock the defence.
67' The foul by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) was seen by John Brooks who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
67' Martin Dubravka (Newcastle Utd) is able to continue to play.
66' Martin Dubravka (Newcastle Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
65' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Martin Dubravka anticipates well and smothers the ball.
65' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.

63' Substitution. Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) has come on for Moussa Diaby.

59' Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
59' He should have scored! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.

22' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left John Brooks no option but to blow his whistle.

21' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
21' What a sweet touch by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Emiliano Martinez to hold.
21' Some great controlled play and passing from Newcastle. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
